html:
An offshore wind turbine TT lies 9 km from the nearest point AA on a straight coast. A power storage facility PP lies on the coast 40 km from AA. Cable is laid in two straight sections, from TT to QQ, where QQ is on the coast xx km from AA, and then from QQ to PP. Coastal cable costs $4000 per km and offshore cable $5000 per km.

  1. Determine to the nearest hundred dollars the cost when QQ is midway from AA to PP. (2 marks)

  2. Show that the cost in thousands of dollars is C=5x2+81−4x+160C=5\sqrt{x^2+81}-4x+160. (2 marks)

  3. Use calculus, with justification, to determine the minimum cost. (4 marks)
